expected_behavior: The focus-change listener must, when isActive is false and a resize is currently in progress, immediately set state.resizing = false -- without applying any extra delta as a side effect of releasing. Regaining focus must not resume the released resize; a subsequent mousePress() starts a genuinely new one. Ordinary press/move/release and focus-loss-with-nothing-active must be unaffected.
allowed_repairs: in the onFocusChange listener, when isActive is false, set state.resizing = false
any equivalent fix that releases the in-progress resize exactly at the moment focus is lost, without deferring to the next mouse event and without applying any stale/queued delta
forbidden_repairs: deferring the release to the next mouseMove/mousePress call instead of releasing inside the focus-change listener itself -- caught by stale_delta_after_focus_loss_does_not_mutate_size, since a delta applied by that next call before releasing still mutates size

releasing only in the isActive===true (refocus) branch instead of at the moment of loss -- caught by focus_loss_during_active_resize_ends_it, which checks resizing===false immediately after setActive(false), before any refocus
permanently disabling resize after one focus-loss event -- caught by fresh_resize_after_refocus_works
disabling mouseMove globally after any focus-change event -- also caught by fresh_resize_after_refocus_works

applying one last queued/stale delta as part of the release itself -- caught by focus_loss_during_active_resize_ends_it, which requires width/height to be unchanged immediately after the release, not just resizing===false
removing mouseRelease()/resize support entirely -- caught by ordinary_resize_works
